Windchill

PTC Windchill provides product data, lifecycle, configuration and change-management workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Trace a product structure

Begin with the controlled identifier, current revision and relationship context. In the intended Windchill preview, trace a product structure; the visible result is the matching record, document or model tree with ownership visible. Review source system, revision, permissions and record identity before accepting or exporting it.

Route a change notice

Use the proposed change, exchange or coordination package. In the intended Windchill preview, route a change notice; the visible result is a versioned change set with affected objects and approvals exposed. Review scope, dependencies, recipients and comparison accuracy before accepting or exporting it.

Review lifecycle state

Start from the release, transmittal or review criteria. In the intended Windchill preview, review lifecycle state; the visible result is a traceable status view with history and outstanding decisions. Review approvers, effective revision, audit trail and delivery state before accepting or exporting it.
